title: Claims Reference Schedule for Fixed Indexed Annuities — Death Benefit and Beneficiary Terms
content:
**Claims department reference schedule — Ashgrove Fixed Indexed Annuities**

| Term | IndexEdge 5 | IndexEdge 7 | IndexEdge 10 | IndexEdge 10 Bonus | IncomeShield 7 | IncomeShield 10 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Surviving spouse who is sole primary beneficiary may continue the contract | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Period from death within which a beneficiary income annuity must begin (months) | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Period from death by which a non-annuitizing beneficiary must take the whole share (years) | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 |
| Death-claim interest, simple annual rate, from due proof to payment | 3.5% | 3.5% | 3.5% | 3.5% | 3.5% | 3.5% |
| Death benefit is the full contract value including any unvested premium bonus | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Maximum number of primary beneficiaries | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Smallest beneficiary share (whole percent) | 1% | 1% | 1% | 1% | 1% | 1% |
| Age below which a share is paid only to a guardian or UTMA custodian | 18 | 18 | 18 | 18 | 18 | 18 |

### Terms restated

- Every tier allows spousal continuation by a surviving spouse who is the sole primary beneficiary.
- A beneficiary income annuity begins within 12 months of the death; a beneficiary who does not annuitize takes the whole share within 5 years of the death.
- Death-claim interest is a simple annual rate of 3.5%.
- The death benefit on every tier includes any unvested premium bonus.
- A designation names at most 10 primary beneficiaries, each share being a whole percent of at least 1%.
- A beneficiary younger than 18 is paid only through a guardian or UTMA custodian.

### Hypothetical readings

| Hypothetical situation | Against the schedule |
|---|---|
| Designation naming 11 primary beneficiaries | Above the maximum of 10 |
| A share of 0.5% | Not a whole percent and below 1% |
| Beneficiary aged 17 at payment | Below 18 |
| Beneficiary aged 18 at payment | Not below 18 |
